decided: When a project signs off at every change's archive, the archive goes on only after the user's answer has been recorded; if recording it fails, the archive stops. If the latest record of a sign-off is damaged or cannot be read, the archive stops and says which, and never treats an older signature as the current one.
alternatives: go on with the archive when the answer could not be recorded
fall back to the latest sign-off that can still be read
why: A signature that was never recorded cannot be shown later, and an older signature may cover different text or have been followed by a decline; stopping and naming the problem keeps the wait the project asked for.
